source_local: all local matches AND exact source host
matching: maximum number of independent document pairs, then maximum shared occurrences; no activation in matching; within each doc pair and exact stratum, minimum absolute position-distance assignment without reuse
aggregation: mean matched occurrence difference within each document pair, then equal document pairs; all fixed members including zeros
uncertainty: 1000document-pair bootstrap draws; each original doc used in at most1pair per token/level; >=5pairs for reported interval
response: native z and fixed R10 high-response indicator both saved; group plot uses mean fraction high across all fixed group members
example_rule: same fixed ID279 and first discovery-ranked near member/domain; highest preferred native-z matched occurrence and its assigned opposite-domain control; no member replacement if inactive; examples illustrate, full matching drives inference

prefix_annotation_codebook.window: last40already-read tokens EXCLUDING target; no later text/source/domain/activation fields passed to proposal function
prefix_annotation_codebook.primary_priority: dominant format(last12tokens>=3markup markers or trailing citation/quote); domain cue+relation; domain cue; intelligible prose>=6English words without listed domain cue; otherwise undetermined
prefix_annotation_codebook.secondary_flags: math cue,bio cue,relation cue,format cue kept independently; mixed cues allowed
